sentences.en: The Japanese economy continued to grow by more than 5% annually.
sentences.zh: 日本经济每年继续以超过5%的速度增长。

sentences.en: How many new jobs does Algeria need to create annually?

sentences.en: About two million pounds of flour are exported annually.
